outputs.notes: Added features/plan/front/components/WeeklyPlanner.tsx: reads lessons/children/subjects/selectedChildIds/selectedSubjectIds from usePlanner() (same PlannerContext WeekGrid/WeeklyList already use). Groups lessons by learner (filtered to selectedChildIds and selectedSubjectIds), each learner rendered exactly once as a collapsible section (button with aria-expanded, reusing WeeklyList's day-section collapsible pattern — same rotate-180 chevron/hover/border treatment, not a new pattern). Within each learner section, lessons are nested by day (Mon-Sun, same week-start-day math copied from WeeklyList); days with zero lessons for that learner render a compact muted marker (data-testid=day-empty-<learnerId>-<dateStr>, just the day label + a dim em-dash) instead of a full card block; days with lessons render data-testid=day-lessons-<learnerId>-<dateStr>. A learner with zero lessons this week (after filters) shows a single muted 'No lessons this week' line instead of 7 empty markers. Learner spine: StudentProfile (features/lib/types.ts) does NOT have a displayColor field — only the DB/children-repository layer (db/schema.ts children.display_color) has one, and it is not plumbed through household context into the type this component receives; adding that plumbing was out of this phase's file scope (would touch features/children/server + household context), so P2 uses a deterministic hash-of-learner-id index into a small local LEARNER_SPINE_COLORS palette in WeeklyPlanner.tsx as the rail/avatar color instead. If a later phase wants the real per-learner displayColor threaded through StudentProfile, that's a scope decision for whoever owns that phase, not silently done here. Card in this phase shows subject (as an eyebrow-style label above title, informally — P3 owns the formal teaching-context-first ordering requirement/tests), title, and a status badge (same STATUS_BADGE/STATUS_LABEL color convention copied from WeeklyList.tsx, matching WeekGrid's green=completed/amber=skipped). No resourceLink indicator yet (that's explicitly P3's testsFirst item). WeeklyPlannerPage.tsx: mobile (isMobile) still renders WeeklyList unchanged; desktop 'matrix' view still renders WeekGrid unchanged; desktop 'planner' view now renders the new WeeklyPlanner instead of WeeklyList. WeekGrid.tsx, WeeklyList.tsx, and LessonTaskForm.tsx were NOT touched, per scope. No db/schema.ts or migration touched. PlannerLessonCard.tsx was NOT extracted in this phase — all card markup is still inline in WeeklyPlanner.tsx; P3's writeBack should record whether it extracts one. P3 must add: subject-before-title ordering test/enforcement, resourceLink -> paperclip indicator (only when resourceLink is set), and match the STATUS_BADGE map already established here (copy, don't reinvent).

outputs.notes: PlannerLessonCard.tsx was NOT extracted — card markup remains inline in WeeklyPlanner.tsx (confirmed decision; the plan explicitly allows this as optional and P2 already established the inline pattern). P4 should add its new indicators directly to the lesson-card block inside WeeklyPlanner.tsx (the `data-lesson-card` div in the per-day lesson map), not to a separate file. Changes made: (1) subject-before-title ordering was already correct from P2 (subject eyebrow div precedes title div in DOM) — added an explicit test asserting DOM order via compareDocumentPosition rather than changing markup. (2) Added a resourceLink indicator: `📎`, rendered only when `lesson.resourceLink` is truthy — presence-only, no placeholder for unset links. (3) Added `data-testid="status-badge"` to the existing status span for test targeting; STATUS_BADGE color map was NOT changed (P2's map already matched WeekGrid's convention: bg-green-100/text-green-700 for completed, bg-amber-100/text-amber-700 for skipped — verified by direct comparison against WeekGrid.tsx's STATUS_BADGE before touching anything, so no edit was needed there). (4) Added an estimatedDuration display (new DURATION_LABEL map, e.g. '30min' -> '30 min') per the plan's card-anatomy field list ('subject eyebrow, title, status dot, resourceLink indicator, duration') — this was not in P3's testsFirst list verbatim but is named as a P2-P3 field in the plan's anatomy diagram, so a minimal render-when-present test was added. (5) Added `data-lesson-card` attribute to each lesson's wrapper div as a stable test/DOM anchor for this and future phases. Also updated two pre-existing P2 tests that broke due to new fixture data added for skipped-status coverage (a new lesson_004 'Spelling review', status skipped, no resourceLink, for child_002/Reading): the 'shows subject, title, status' test now uses getAllByText for 'Reading' since it appears on two cards, and the day-empty/day-lessons comment was corrected to reflect Layth now having two populated days. No curriculum/chapter/hasHomework/hasAssessment fields were added anywhere — those remain explicitly out of scope for P4. No db/schema.ts or migration touched. WeekGrid.tsx was read for comparison but not modified.
